about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Full-Stack Software Engineer
paragraphs: I'm Irfan, a Full-Stack Software Engineer based in Indonesia with 3+ years of experience delivering mobile, web, and backend solutions across the banking, mining, and manufacturing industries. I specialize in cross-platform mobile applications with React Native, supported by robust backend services and REST APIs.

Working in security-sensitive and operations-heavy environments has taught me to prioritize reliability, security, and maintainability. In banking, I built mobile applications and Spring Boot microservices alongside QA and security teams on penetration testing, SAST, and DAST. In mining, I lead mobile development for internal corporate applications, and in manufacturing, I delivered a production management system and a recruitment portal.

I work across the full development lifecycle, from API design with Spring Boot and Laravel to responsive interfaces and releases on the Play Store, App Store, and AppGallery. My toolkit spans React Native, TypeScript, Java, PHP, and Golang, backed by solid experience with relational databases. I bring strong problem-solving skills, a collaborative mindset, and a commitment to high-quality, maintainable software.
